question: Which of the following is an example of a synthetic polymer used in industry?
solution: The correct answer is __**Nylon-6,6**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • **Nylon-6,6** is a **synthetic polymer** widely used in industrial applications. It is produced by the polymerization of **hexamethylenediamine** and **adipic acid**, which are petroleum-based monomers. • This polymer has **high tensile strength**, excellent resistance to wear and abrasion, and is used in products like **textiles, automotive parts, and industrial components**. • Nylon-6,6 is classified as a **thermoplastic material**, meaning it becomes moldable at high temperatures and solidifies upon cooling, making it ideal for manufacturing purposes. • In contrast to natural polymers like starch and cellulose, which are derived from biological sources, Nylon-6,6 is entirely synthetic, originating from **chemical processes.** • Its durability and resistance to environmental factors make it a preferred material in the production of **ropes, machine parts, and even parachutes**.
